verdict.rationale: Signifyd's API lets merchants submit chargeback and representment outcome events (createchargeback, representmentoutcome) which represent confirmed fraud outcomes reported back to Signifyd, implying some feedback loop for model training, but there is no documentation showing that analyst review decisions themselves are captured or that these outcomes are explicitly used to retrain rules/models. Missing for 10: explicit description of analyst review-decision capture, confirmation that chargeback/representment data feeds into ML model retraining, and any case-management/review-queue documentation showing the learning loop in action.
